openDecisions.question: Which collation name, and is one name enough? Empirically: two DIFFERENT non-default collations meeting in a UNION ALL or COALESCE raise 'could not determine which collation to use for string comparison'. One non-default plus the database default resolves to the non-default with no error. book-library-read.repository.ts:315-333 UNIONs book_purchase_info.store_name with book_store_links.store_name, and publishers.repository.ts:509-517 COALESCEs publisher_names.name (:511) with publishers.name (:516) - so a mixed-name rollout would be a runtime 500.
options: uk-UA-x-icu everywhere (spec's choice, matches the empirical test)
uk-x-icu everywhere (language-only, same ordering, shorter)
und-x-icu everywhere (CLDR root, correct for Ukrainian and neutral for English titles)
